use: the oracle of the stale-current measure, judged against the target version v1.0.1. One fact is one unit of counting. A removed, replaced or changed fact stated as current for v1.0.1 is an error. A control fact stays true: marking it superseded is an error. A statement explicitly scoped to an older version (for example 'in v0.3.0 ...') or to older clients is not an error. Each fact quotes where it held and where it ended; since is the release that ended it (v1.0.0 is not in the corpus: its changes are read in the v1.0.1 changelog, in the summary of v1 and in the v1.0.1 specification)
selection: facts with a quote in the specification of v0.2.5 or v0.3.0 and a quote that ends them in a later file of the corpus; additions of v1.0 (ListTasks, multi-tenancy, timestamps) are not facts that ended and are left out
author: claude-opus-5-5, 2026-11-13, before any run on the corpus; to be reviewed by Codex; every quote is checked verbatim by benchmarks/test_a2a_corpus.py
